    portfolio

    Open Source Repositories

    Published: October 25, 2026

    • Fast Multi-robot Exploration
      This repository contains a decentralized multi-robot explorer that coordinates a team of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to explore forests.
    • SMB Path Planner
      Repository for the path planner for SMB for the ETH Robotics Summer School
    • Multi-robot Coordination
      This repository contains a hierachical multi-robot global planner that generates paths for a team of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).
    • Pose-graph Backend
      This repository contains an optimization-based pose-graph backend for multi-agent sensor fusion, used in a wider framework for multi-robot path planning.
    • Multirotors Landing
      This repository contains an deep reinforcement learning-based lander for UAVs using semantic and depth informatiom.
    • Pointcloud Utilities
      Set of ROS nodes to do some processing with pointclouds.

    publications

    Active Learning for UAV-based Semantic Mapping

    Published in Workshop on Informative Path Planning and Active Sampling, Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS), 2019

    “Addressing the labor-intensive bottleneck of training data collection in vision-based UAV applications, our novelty-aware path planner is validated on real-world terrain mapping datasets, yielding substantially smaller, more informative training datasets compared to standard lawnmower pattern collection.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    A Fully-Integrated Sensing and Control System for High-Accuracy Mobile Robotic Building Construction

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2019

    Implemented on a real platform under realistic construction conditions, the proposed system enables fully autonomous mobile manipulators to achieve sub-centimeter positioning accuracy using solely on-board sensing. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Perception-aware Path Planning for UAVs using Semantic Segmentation

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2020

    We present a perception-aware path-planning pipeline for UAVs that leverages semantic segmentation to avoid texture-less or problematic areas, such as bodies of water, that degrade monocular VIO state estimation, actively steering the robot toward perceptually informative regions. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Multi-robot Coordination with Agent-Server Architecture for Autonomous Navigation in Partially Unknown Environments

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2020

    We present a server-agent system architecture for multi-robot autonomous navigation in partially unknown environments, where computationally demanding tasks like global mapping and path planning are outsourced to a central server, while agents handle local pose estimation and obstacle avoidance onboard. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Semantic-aware Active Perception for UAVs using Deep Reinforcement Learning

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2021

    We present a semantic-aware path-planning pipeline for UAVs that uses deep reinforcement learning to evaluate the perceptual informativeness of visible semantic classes. By training on semantic cues across non-photorealistic, randomly generated scenes, the deep policy network successfully generalizes to unseen environments while guiding the UAV away from perceptually degraded regions. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Informed Sampling Exploration Path Planner for 3D Reconstruction of Large Scenes

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2021

    Addressing MAV computational and energy constraints, our frontier-based informed sampling approach streamlines viewpoint evaluation to accelerate autonomous exploration, outperforming state-of-the-art planners in both exploration speed and final 3D reconstruction quality. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Fully Autonomous Live 3D Reconstruction with an MAV: Hardware- and Software-Setup

    Published in Research Demos at International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV), 2021

    We present a versatile Micro-Aerial Vehicle (MAV) setup demonstrating fully autonomous live 3D reconstruction in real-world scenarios. With the aim of reproducability we provide key information on both the hardware- and software-setup. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Autonomous Emergency Landing for Multicopters using Deep Reinforcement Learning

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    We present an autonomous emergency landing pipeline for multicopters that handles critical failures, such as mechanical malfunctions, GPS jamming, or sudden battery drops. By leveraging semantic and depth representations, our policy achieves direct zero-shot transfer to the real world without requiring any additional fine-tuning. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    T-PRM: Temporal Probabilistic Roadmap for Path Planning in Dynamic Environments

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    Temporal-PRM maintains the core advantages of traditional PRM—such as multi-query capabilities and smooth path generation—while enabling collision-free navigation in highly dynamic, cluttered environments, operating in real time onboard a flying robot. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Voxfield: Non-Projective Signed Distance Fields for Online Planning and 3D Reconstruction

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    Outperforming state-of-the-art methods in map coverage, accuracy, and processing speed, Voxfield operates effectively onboard compute-constrained micro-aerial vehicles (MAVs), generating accurate ESDF maps to enable real-time trajectory planning and obstacle avoidance. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Decentralised Multi-Robot Exploration Using Monte Carlo Tree Search

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    Addressing real-world challenges in inspection and surveying, the proposed DMCE strategy enables efficient, decentralized multi-robot exploration across unknown environments, outperforming state-of-the-art planners and greedy baselines with up to a 30% reduction in exploration time. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Sweep-Your-Map: Efficient Coverage Planning for Aerial Teams in Large-Scale Environments

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2022

    Addressing the strict battery and flight-time constraints of small drones in large-scale outdoor missions, our pipeline generates structured task partitions to achieve comprehensive visual coverage significantly faster than state-of-the-art exploration baselines. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Towards Robust Active Planning for Autonomous Aerial Navigation

    Published in ETH Doctoral Examination, 2023

    Focusing on vision-based navigation in challenging, GPS-denied scenarios, this work pioneers the use of semantic cues for active path planning. By integrating semantic segmentation with deep reinforcement learning, the proposed frameworks actively steer MAVs toward visually reliable scene structures while avoiding perceptually degraded regions—improving VI-SLAM accuracy, trajectory robustness, and autonomous emergency landing capabilities.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Fast multi-UAV decentralized exploration of forests

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2023

    Addressing the challenges of high obstacle density and long-distance wireless communication limits in UAV fleets, our multi-robot exploration framework achieves complete coverage of complex forest environments up to 30% faster than state-of-the-art baselines. Video available here.

    teaching

    ETH Robotics Summer School

    Summer School, ETH Zürich, 2019

    Organized and led the hands-on tutorial on path planning at the ETH Zürich Robotics Summer School from 2019 to 2022. The program brought together high-achieving Master’s and PhD researchers from world-renowned universities.
